name: Monoleaf
subtitle: Markdown, diagrams, and notes
promotionalText: Read Markdown in a focused Mac viewer. Browse folders, follow document links, and keep highlights, comments, and notes beside your documents.
description:
Monoleaf is a Markdown reader for Mac. Open a file or folder and read rendered Markdown in configurable monospace type.

Use one left sidebar for Files, Contents, Links, and History. Keep several documents open in native Mac tabs, and switch between recent folder workspaces.

Read tables, highlighted code, local images, LaTeX equations, Mermaid diagrams, and emoji. Copy code, table data, diagram source, and rendered artifacts through nearby controls.

Highlight selected text, attach comments, and keep Markdown or plain-text reading notes in the right sidebar. Reading data stays in the app. Source documents change only when you choose to export reading data to them. Export an annotated copy, a separate reading-data file, inline comments, or a generated section at the end.

Adjust fonts, text sizes, light and dark palettes, and reading layout. Use Pages or Pageless view, an optional source-line gutter, and standard Mac commands for opening, copying, printing, and zooming. Choose automatic file reload or refresh manually.

Monoleaf needs no account. Document rendering and reading-data storage run locally. Remote images are blocked, and external links open in your browser.

Monoleaf is a viewer. It does not provide a Markdown source editor.

privacy.thirdPartyCode: Bundled Markdown, highlighting, math, diagram, emoji, and sanitization libraries. No remote rendering service.
